name: Kedemoth
brief: A town in Moab, later a Levitical city in Reuben
short: Kedemoth, a town in Moab from which Moses sent messengers to Sihon, later became a Levitical city within the territory of Reuben (<ref="Deu.2.26; Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79">Deu.2.26; Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79</ref>).
